site.title: Artiani
site.description: A clean V2 foundation for the Artiani Next.js app.
contact.helpBodyPrimary: If you have any questions, contact us by email or phone.
contact.helpBodySecondary: We’ll be happy to help with payment, delivery, or order details.
page.home.title: Home
page.home.body: This is the new Artiani V2 shell. Product, checkout, and tracking flows will be rebuilt here.
home.media.title: From studio, screen, and public life.
home.media.empty: Selected media will appear here once the first curated cards are published.
home.aboutArtiani.title: Artiani brings artworks closer to everyday life.
home.aboutArtiani.body: Artiani is a curated space where Levan Margiani's paintings continue as objects for the home: textiles, scarves, pillows, runners, cloths, and other pieces shaped by colour, ornament, and daily use.
home.aboutArtist.title: Levan Margiani works across painting, ornament, and material memory.
home.aboutArtist.body: His practice moves between image and object, carrying painted worlds into forms that feel intimate, tactile, and lived with. This is a short introduction for now; the fuller biography can grow later.
home.hero.body: A calm new storefront for Levan Margiani's textile objects, built around material, ornament, and a slower way of choosing pieces for the home.
home.hero.fallback: Featured products will appear here as soon as active Supabase items are available for the homepage.
home.artist.title: Levan Margiani
home.artist.body: Artiani gathers Levan's textile practice into a more deliberate shop experience, where pattern, tactility, and domestic use sit as closely as the artwork itself.
page.biography.title: Biography
page.biography.body: Biography content will be added in the next phase.
page.catalogue.title: Catalogue
page.catalogue.body: Browse the current Artiani textile collection.
catalogue.heading: Current collection
catalogue.intro: All active Supabase products are gathered here and grouped into the current textile families for easier browsing.
catalogue.empty: No matching products are available right now.
page.cart.title: Cart
page.cart.body: Cart behavior is intentionally paused while the new storefront flow is designed.
cart.summary: Selected items are stored locally in your browser.
cart.emptyBody: Your basket is empty. Add a product from the catalogue to start building the order.
page.track.title: Track order
page.track.body: Use your order code with your email or phone to view matching orders.
checkout.title: Complete your order
checkout.body: Share your delivery details and review the basket before placing the order.
checkout.phoneHint: Use digits, spaces, parentheses, or a leading + only.
checkout.deliveryNoteAddress: Please enter your address accurately and in full to avoid delivery delays.
checkout.deliveryNoteFee: Delivery fee in Tbilisi is 5 GEL, and in the regions it is 10 GEL.
checkout.deliveryNoteTiming: Delivery takes up to 5 working days in Tbilisi and up to 7 working days in the regions.
checkout.paymentProcessBodyPrimary: After confirming your order, you will receive payment instructions on the screen and by email. Please transfer the amount to the provided account and include your order code in the payment reference.
checkout.paymentProcessBodySecondary: Once the payment is received, order processing will begin. Delivery takes about 5 working days in Tbilisi and about 7 working days in the regions.
checkout.errorGeneric: Something went wrong. Please try again.
checkout.confirmationHint: Your order code appears immediately after a successful submission.
checkout.emptyBody: Your basket is empty. Add products before moving to checkout.
checkout.successEmailSent: Your order was saved and the confirmation email was sent.
checkout.successEmailFailed: Your order was saved, but the confirmation email could not be sent.
checkout.successNext: Keep your order code and complete the bank transfer below so order processing can begin.
checkout.nextStepsBody: Please transfer the amount to one of the bank accounts below and make sure to include the order code in the transfer description.
checkout.afterPaymentBody: After payment, order processing will begin as soon as the transfer is confirmed.
checkout.copyHintBody: Use the buttons to quickly copy the code, IBAN, and amount.
checkout.transferBody: Use one of the bank accounts below and include your order code in the transfer reference.
checkout.transferNote: Use your order code exactly as the transfer reference. We will confirm the order after the transfer is received.
track.title: Track order
track.body: Enter your order code and your email or phone to find matching orders.
track.notFound: No matching orders were found for that code and contact.
